name: Colorado River (Professor Valley / Moab Daily)
blurb: Upper Colorado along Utah Highway 128: flatwater from Cisco and Dewey Bridge, then the Class I-III Moab Daily (Fisher Towers section).

sections.notes: Flatwater. Miles (16.0) are NHD High Resolution centreline-routed between the agency points; no agency mileage found.

Flatwater. The 6.6-mile catalog distance is a mapped centerline estimate. Utah’s 2025 river plan lists approximately 6.5 miles; BLM lists 7.5. The dotted line is a river-course overview, not an adopted distance or navigation route. Dewey’s developed boat ramp is steep; use caution with vehicles.
sections.distanceReview: Utah’s 2025 river plan describes approximately 6.5 miles, while the BLM recreation page lists 7.5. The existing 6.6-mile planning value is retained. A reviewed dotted river overview is available, but the agency mileage difference remains unresolved and trip-time estimates stay withheld.

sections.notes: BLM Moab Daily (Fisher Towers section): 13 miles, rapids Class I to Class III depending on season and water level. NPS Canyonlands: 'Permits are not required for overnight use or launches on BLM land along the Colorado River.'

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
